title: WizCommerce - AI-powered B2B wholesale sales platform
clean_text: WizCommerce is an AI-powered sales and ecommerce platform built for wholesale distributors, manufacturers, and brands. The platform is organized around four core products: WizOrder, an AI-first order-taking app for sales reps; WizShop, a wholesale-native B2B ecommerce storefront; WizStudio, AI-powered catalog and product imagery generation; and WizPay, embedded B2B payments. It explicitly offers AI-driven personalized product recommendations and intelligent search based on buyer behavior and purchase history. The platform integrates with ERP and accounting systems including QuickBooks, NetSuite, and Fishbowl, and supports multi-channel order taking across tradeshows, field sales, and online. Founded in 2020, the company raised an $8M Series A round in August 2025 led by Peak XV Partners, bringing total funding to $13.5M.
